scientific_integrity: Analytic infinite-family proof with a standalone finite and symbolic test script. Prior balanced exact optimal weights and extended-barbell optimum results are explicitly credited. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric uniform-stationary chains on one-bridge joins of two cliques of orders at least five; near-optimality is relative to the explicit universal benchmark; exact optimizer faces and nonreversible dynamics are excluded; publication-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Uniform bridge-weight rigidity and sharp stability exponents for near-fastest mixing on unequal clique barbells
